evaluation.summary: The CV is clean, readable and well-sectioned, showing real evidence such as accessibility work, Storybook, React/TypeScript projects and a First Class degree. The main problems are the Full-Stack title, the unsupported Figma skill, and cover-letter wording that presents academic backend work as practical experience. Fit is limited by the lack of professional experience, e2e testing, security and health-data evidence, which the outputs leave visible. Layout and language are good.
